Creatinine Clearance — Cockcroft-Gault

Estimate creatinine clearance using Cockcroft-Gault for drug dosing and renal assessment.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

CrCl = [(140 − age) × weight (kg) × 1.23 (male) or 1.04 (female)] / Scr (µmol/L)

Clinical interpretation

  • ≥90: Normal
  • 60–89: Mildly reduced
  • 30–59: Moderately reduced
  • 15–29: Severely reduced
  • <15: Kidney failure range

Use ideal or actual body weight based on muscle mass and obesity. Not identical to GFR.

References

  • Cockcroft-Gault equation
